name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 29 times in 8 visits over 56 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
